name: Magnetic Field Hall Effect Sensor
description: Like a magnetic compass detector! Senses proximity of permanent magnetic fields (neodymium magnets).
realWorldAnalogy: Like a magnetic compass detector! Senses proximity of permanent magnetic fields (neodymium magnets).
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and OUT (Green) to digital pin 2 with a 10k pull-up resistor to 5V.
commonMistakes: Omitting the 10k pull-up resistor (the 3144 has an open-collector output).
Testing with the wrong magnetic pole (3144 detects South magnetic poles only).

miniExperiment.title: Magnetic Field Detector
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to Pin 2 with 10k pullup.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Approaching the sensor with the South pole of a magnet triggers 'MAGNET DETECTED!' in Serial Monitor.
